info.name: CampusMart API
info.description:
Test collection for the CampusMart backend (FastAPI).

1. Start the API: uvicorn app.main:app --reload
2. Import this file into Postman.
3. Check the collection variables (baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword).
4. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order. It registers two fresh users, runs every endpoint with positive and negative cases, and deletes the test users at the end.

Command line: newman run CampusMart.postman_collection.json

exec: pm.test("API reports ok", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql("ok"); });

item.name: 1. Auth

exec: pm.test("Returns the new user without any password", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("sellerEmail")); pm.expect(json).to.not.have.property("password_hash"); pm.expect(json).to.not.have.property("password"); });
pm.test("Phone is normalised to 256 format", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.phone).to.eql("256771234567"); });
pm.test("New users are students", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.role).to.eql("student"); });

pm.test("Never exposes phone numbers in lists", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); json.forEach(i => pm.expect(i.seller.phone).to.be.null); });

exec: pm.test("Message saved unread", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.is_read).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.body).to.eql("Is it still available?"); });

item.name: Message a user that does not exist

exec: pm.test("Shows an unread chat with the buyer", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); const c = json.find(x => x.other_user_id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("buyerId"))); pm.expect(c).to.exist; pm.expect(c.unread_count).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(c.item_title).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Contains the message", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.map(m => m.body)).to.include("Is it still available?"); });

item.name: Inbox again: the chat is now read

exec: pm.test("No unread messages", function () { const json = pm.response.json(); const c = json.find(x => x.other_user_id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("buyerId"))); pm.expect(c.unread_count).to.eql(0); });
